basic_info.description: 10 South Park #7 is an extremely rare south-facing loft condominium overlooking South Park. This one bedroom two bathroom loft condominium has exceptional natural light. Additional features include radiant floor heating, gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances & breakfast bar, west-facing balcony perfect for morning coffee, wood burning fireplace, vaulted ceilings, skylight, additional storage room, in-unit laundry & parking.
